data_source: PhysioNet EEGBCI eegmmidb v1.0.0 original EDF
chronological_split: Within each real EDF, sorted original T1/T2 epochs: earliest n-ceil(n/3) train, last ceil(n/3) clean heldout. Extract 0.5-2.5s windows relative to event, no train/test raw overlap.
counterfactual: In original RAW recordings, multiply C3 only inside all training event raw windows by 1+alpha (alpha=0.05,0.20,0.50). No test raw sample changed. Refilter entire recording separately, construct changed train log-bandpowers. Evaluate on identical ORIGINAL clean heldout features; this is a synthetic train sensor gain intervention, not a spontaneously observed real artifact or train/test label leakage.
fixed_preprocessing: SciPy sosfiltfilt whole recording, Butterworth 4th order 1-30Hz at 160Hz; C3/C4, log mean square Hann rFFT power in 8-12 and 13-30Hz band per channel; 4 features. Original train-only standardization fixed for BOTH clean and perturbed models.
fixed_model: L2-penalized binary logistic loss plus lambda/2 ||theta||^2 with explicit regularized intercept in augmented 5D features; lambda=0.5 and fixed optimization residual <=1e-7.
primary_outcome: person-level mean across two runs and three fixed gains of (Hessian tight certificate coverage - lambda-only certificate coverage) over identical clean heldout trials; outcomes from eight independent persons, not 48 independent EDF-gain datasets.
secondary_outcomes: any refit class flip by scale
false certificate claim count (required zero, else methodology failure)
per subject and scale exact source EDF SHA256
subject-level descriptive 95% bootstrap with 2000 resamples fixed seed 20261013
positive_go_no_go: At least 5 percentage points improvement in person-averaged tight certificate coverage, zero false certified flip and at least two independent people have a nonzero positive gain. This is a project go/no-go threshold, not a pre-specified statistical hypothesis of population significance.
negative_controls: gain=0 exact data should not generate source-change effects (tested in unit tests); full change exactly to registered C3 training raw windows; all original raw test windows and original labels untouched; no per-scale retuning
failure_rules: abort if any subject/run/source checksum missing, training event overlap, two-class labels absent or train/test denominator incorrect
abort on any optimizer residual >1e-7, certificate false positive, altered clean test sources or floating nonfinite
do not drop zero-effect participants, runs or gain levels
prior_art_and_claim_boundary: Strong convexity and curvature Hessian bounds are standard, and JMLR 2026 AGT already addresses broader training-data perturbation certificates. Successful numerical coverage would not establish novelty, formal float interval proof, clinical diagnosis improvement, or advantage over AGT; only matched lambda-only bound and honest new-person performance are evaluated here.
external_recognition: Official MOABB API merge, independent institution replication and scholarly review are not established by a passing fork Actions job.
